Privacy notice · Updated October 17, 2026

When you ask for an estimate

The form collects your name, property address, preferred contact method, phone number or email address, and any job details or calculator estimate you choose to include. Lakeland Elite Power Washing LLC uses these details to respond, prepare a quote and arrange requested service. Please do not include payment card details or other sensitive information in the form.

How your request reaches Rob

Online requests are processed through Formspree. Your request includes the service page used so Rob knows what you are asking about. If you use a phone, text or email link, your device and the relevant communications provider handle that communication.

Read Formspree’s privacy policy ↗

Website and advertising measurement

The main website uses Google Analytics and Google Ads tags to understand website visits, advertising activity and actions such as quote submissions or contact-link clicks. Google tools may use cookies or similar technologies, depending on your browser settings. Our custom analytics events do not include the contact details or job description entered in your form.

How Google uses information from partner sites ↗

Information on your device

The full website calculator can remember selected services and measurements in local browser storage. Its save feature does not store the form’s contact details. You can use “Clear saved estimate” in that calculator or clear your browser’s site data. A short-lived submission marker in session storage helps avoid counting the same thank-you visit repeatedly.

Questions or corrections

To ask about information you have provided, request a correction, or discuss a deletion request, contact Rob at rob@lakelandelitepowerwashing.com or (863) 362-4188. Requests are reviewed in light of any records needed for ongoing service or business recordkeeping.
